summary: Introduces extensions to Mobile IPv6 and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery for handling local mobility. A Mobility Anchor Point reduces the signaling between a moving device, its correspondents and its home agent. It is experimental and was replaced by RFC 5380.

eli5.summary: When you move around inside a big building, a front desk can forward your mail so far-away friends do not need your new room each time. The anchor point acts like that front desk for moving devices.
